mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline > 1% MoM does not correlate with subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in robust demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the described condition does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a stable unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in healthy labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) coupled with rising Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals supply constraints and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the described condition does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.
